assumptions.what: PSI as a proportion: SES inclusion = mean reads of the two inclusion junctions, PSI = inclusion / (inclusion + skipping); MES uses the mean over the skipped junctions; two alternative junctions: r1 / (r1 + r2)
assumptions.sensitivity: Additional file 1's formulas are equation objects that do not survive conversion (they read as ratios that are not proportions); this reading gives the PSI values printed in Additional files 8 and 9 for the events whose read counts we share.

assumptions.what: Class rules of Additional file 1 written as code: SES = exactly one inclusion path through one annotated exon; A5SS/A3SS = two junctions sharing one edge whose exons share the other edge; AFE/ALE = alternative annotated first/last exons with no junction into their outer edge; MXE = two exons between shared edges with no junction joining them and no exon between them; named by transcript strand; events need dPSI > 0.2
assumptions.sensitivity: The paper's iteration order and tie rules are not given; an event can belong to more than one class here.

page.lede: Weischenfeldt and colleagues mapped RNA-seq of NMD-deficient mouse liver and macrophages with RAINMAN, a pipeline that is gone. We rebuilt it from the paper and reran it from the reads. Of {attempted} results we tried, {exact} came back exactly, {agrees} agree, {partly} partly agree and {differs} differ.
